preconditions.description: Attacker must deploy a malicious contract with receive/fallback function capable of re-entering multiSendETH
Attacker needs sufficient ETH to call multiSendETH with msg.value

exploit_hint: 1. Deploy a malicious contract with a receive() function that re-enters multiSendETH when receiving ETH. 2. Call multiSendETH with the malicious contract as one of the recipients in the _recipients array. 3. During the ETH transfer loop, the malicious contract's receive() function triggers and re-enters multiSendETH before the totalAmount validation completes. 4. This allows the attacker to potentially drain more ETH than the original msg.value by exploiting the lack of re-entrancy guard and state updates before external calls.
